pairs: quoniam exaudiet Dominus vocem orationis meæ.
therefore, the Lord will heed the voice of my prayer.
For he has inclined his ear to me.
And in my days, I will call upon him.
The sorrows of death have surrounded me,
and the perils of Hell have found me.
I have found tribulation and sorrow.
et nomen Domini invocavi: o Domine,
And so, I called upon the name of the Lord.
The Lord is the keeper of little ones.
For the Lord has done good to you.
quia eripuit animam meam de morte,
For he has rescued my soul from death,
I will please the Lord in the land of the living.
